quickStart.title: Find a normal-distribution percentile
quickStart.description: Calculate the 95th percentile of a standard normal distribution, then check its cumulative probability.
quickStart.sql:
SELECT round(dist_normal_quantile(0.0, 1.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95,
       round(dist_normal_cdf(0.0, 1.0, 1.6448536269514722), 2) AS probability;
quickStart.note: The parameters describe a standard normal distribution: mean 0 and standard deviation 1. This computes a theoretical quantile, not a percentile of an observed table.

introduction.title: Calculate probabilities and draw samples in SQL
paragraphs: Stochastic provides probability distributions through a consistent set of SQL functions. Depending on the distribution, you can evaluate a density, calculate a cumulative probability or quantile, and generate random samples.

Use it for synthetic datasets, probability calculations alongside existing rows, or small simulation experiments. Choose the distribution and its parameters to match the problem. These functions calculate from that choice; they do not infer a statistical model from your data.
